name: Honda Silver Wing (FSC600)
engine: 582 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected, CVT
intro: Honda's 600 twin maxi-scooter. Early 2002-2004 bikes had several recalls, from the rear wheel to the stand.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2002 Silver Wings had a rear wheel recall (02V250), 2002-2003 bikes a handlebar recall (03V513), and 2002-2004 bikes a stand recall (04V290).
A-002.reason: These are old, but a bike that missed them still has the fault.

recalls.what: Rear wheel spokes can fail and the wheel can collapse.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear wheel free.

recalls.what: Handlebar problem that could cause a loss of steering control.
Kickstand or center stand can come loose and fall off.
